criteria.reason: Partly: explains normal wear and tear but omits bank-account rule and mis-cites Art. 267 for damage responsibility.
Does not claim to be a lawyer or guarantee the user will win or recover the deposit.
Names Schlichtungsbehörde and a real tenant-advice body; no invented agencies, though Mieterverband not named.
Provides concrete steps, evidence gathering, follow-up options, and a usable draft letter.

factual_errors: Art. 267 CO is cited for damage beyond normal wear and tear, but it concerns security deposits.
summary: Practical and mostly compliant, but incomplete on deposit rules and missing an explicit disclaimer about judging the specific case.
